params.name: api-invoker-id
params.description: String identifying the API invoker assigned by the CAPIF core function. It also represents the CCF identifier in the CAPIF-6/6e interface.

params.name: api-name
params.description: Contains the API name set to the value of the "<apiName>" placeholder of the API URI as defined in clause 5.2.4 of 3GPP TS 29.122 [14].

params.name: api-version
params.description: API major version the URI (e.g. v1).

params.name: comm-type
params.description: Communication type used by the API (e.g. REQUEST_RESPONSE).

params.name: data-format
params.description: Data formats used by the API (e.g. serialization protocol JSON used).

params.name: api-cat
params.description: The service API category to which the service API belongs to.

params.name: req-api-prov-name
params.description: Represents the required API provider name.

params.name: api-supported-features
params.description: Features supported by the discovered service API indicated by api-name parameter. This may only be present if api-name query parameter is present.

params.name: ue-ip-addr
params.description: Represents the UE IP address information.

params.name: service-kpis
params.description: Contains iInformation about service characteristics provided by the targeted  service API(s).

params.name: net-slice-info
params.description: Contains the identifier(s) of the network slice(s) within which the API shall be available.

params.name: grant-types
params.description: Contains the OAuth grant types that need to be supported.

params.name: api-ids
params.description: Contains the identifier(s) of the targeted service APIs. When this query parameter is present, then all the other query parameters shall be absent except the supported-features and api-invoker-id query parameters.

params.name: res-ops
params.description: Contains the list of supported API resource(s) and service operation(s).

params.name: supported-features
params.description: Features supported by the NF consumer for the CAPIF Discover Service API.

items.docs: Discover published service APIs and retrieve a collection of APIs according to certain filter criteria.
